data.description: The figure is a BHA (Bottom Hole Assembly) graphical report for well ID Forge 56-32, located in the UTAHFORGE field. The BHA consists of various components including HWDP (Heavy Weight Drill Pipe), DC (Drill Collar), SHOCK, MONEL, STAB, OTHER, MMTR, and BIT. Each component is detailed with its length in feet and inches, top thread specifications, serial number, and the distance from the top to the bit.
